purpose: Falsify detector quality before Unit 002-R by measuring sensitivity, specificity, witness localization, and deterministic repeatability on predeclared synthetic mutations of already-qualified preserved calibration seeds.

positive_semantic_loss_operators.mutation: Replace target.derivation.program.mechanism.expr with a literal native accept-kind result while leaving the source contract and all other compiled fields unchanged.
Replace target.derivation.program.discriminator.expr with a literal constant while leaving mechanism, interpreter, source contract, and remaining compiled fields unchanged.
Replace target.derivation.program.interpreter.expr with a literal C-space success consequence while leaving the source contract and all other compiled fields unchanged.

negative_nonsemantic_operators.mutation: Change only case.json convenience metadata fields that are not semantic assurance inputs.
Reverse only the order of target adapter provenance.edges; preserve the exact node and edge set.
Reverse only the order of target.derivation.facts; preserve the exact fact objects and set.

predeclared_metrics.baseline_validity: 2/2 seeds must satisfy the expected preserved semantic baseline on both repeats.
predeclared_metrics.positive_sensitivity: 6/6 distinct positive mutants must satisfy their operator-specific detection predicate on both repeats.
predeclared_metrics.negative_specificity: 6/6 distinct negative mutants must retain the seed baseline semantic view on both repeats; false semantic alarms must be 0/6.
predeclared_metrics.regression_witness_localization: For P_MECHANISM_ALWAYS_ACCEPTS and P_INTERPRETER_ALWAYS_SUCCESS, 4/4 seed/operator pairs must localize a minimal mismatch to the seed's predeclared stale coordinate on both repeats.
predeclared_metrics.discriminator_detection: For P_DISCRIMINATOR_COLLAPSE, 2/2 seeds must cease to report D1 on both repeats.
predeclared_metrics.deterministic_repeatability: All 12 distinct mutants must produce identical semantic views across their two repeats; baseline repeats must also match.
predeclared_metrics.source_contract_invariance: Every mutant source-contract file SHA-256 must equal its seed baseline source-contract file SHA-256.
predeclared_metrics.mutation_locality: Each operator must change only its predeclared compiled-field surface; any extra semantic-field delta invalidates that mutant rather than being silently accepted.

promotion_rule: Unit 002-M passes only if every baseline, sensitivity, specificity, localization, repeatability, source-invariance, and mutation-locality requirement passes. Partial success is not promoted.
failure_interpretation: A failed control falsifies the current detector/control implementation or reveals a predeclared expectation mismatch. It must not be repaired by deleting or replacing a failed mutation after outputs are observed; any redesigned matrix is a new versioned experiment.
next_gate_if_promoted: Unit 002-R real prospective falsification with target selection independent of Unit 002-M outcomes.
